name: Social Media Feed Gallery – Fetch Posts & Reels
author: A WP Life

sections.description:
Showcase your Instagram photos on your website easily.
This social media gallery pulls images from your instagram account with an access token.
Your feed appears in a clean grid.
It looks great on any screen size.

View Pro Demo: Social Media Feed Gallery Premium
More About Pro Version: Social Media Feed Gallery Premium Details
Where To Buy: Buy Social Media Feed Gallery Premium

Video Guides

How to Generate an Access Token

External services

This plugin relies on the Instagram Graph API to fetch media content (images and videos) from your Instagram account to display in your gallery.

  • Service: Instagram Graph API (Meta Platforms, Inc.)
  • What data is sent: Your Instagram Access Token, media IDs, and query parameters to specify image/video fields and limits.
  • When data is sent: Data is sent via a server-side request (wp_remote_get) every time the gallery shortcode is loaded on your site.
  • Privacy & Terms:
    • Instagram Data Policy
    • Meta Privacy Policy
    • Instagram Terms of Use

Free Features

  • Access token authentication
  • 1 gallery layout (Grid)
  • Rows and columns control
  • Display up to 50 images
  • Adjustable image spacing
  • Caption overlay on hover
  • Direct links to feed posts
  • Lightbox image preview
  • Lightbox navigation controls
  • Shortcode generator
  • Responsive design
  • Translation ready

Pro Features

Upgrade to access additional layouts and extended functionality:

  • 5 gallery layout templates (Grid, Masonry, Mosaic, Carousel, Post)
  • Display 200+ images per gallery
  • Album support
  • Like count display
  • Comment count display
  • User profile information
  • Load More button for pagination
  • Social sharing icons
  • No-spacing layout option
  • Custom link settings
  • Custom CSS field
  • Lightbox color customization
  • Priority support

Complete Setup Tutorial

The setup process takes just a few minutes.
Enter your access token and adjust display settings.
Drop the shortcode wherever you want.
It works with pages, posts, and widgets.

Create a Custom Instagram Feed

Add a clean instagram feed to your site.
Display your latest photos automatically.
It takes just a few steps to connect.
Get your access token and paste it in.
Your website will update when you post.

Beautiful Instagram Gallery Layout

Customize how your instagram gallery displays.
Control spacing, column counts, and captions.
Key features of this social media gallery:

  • Select column layout options from 1 to 6.
  • Adjust spacing between images for a custom look.
  • Show captions when users hover over photos.
  • Open each instagram post in a clean lightbox.
  • Direct visitors to the original instagram photo feed link.

Display Instagram Reels and Videos

Share more than just static images.
You can display your instagram reels and videos.
A video play icon shows on video thumbnails.
Visitors can view your videos from the gallery.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the Plugins screen in your dashboard.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to “Insta Feed” in your admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your access token and configure display settings.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I get an access token?

Access tokens are created through Facebook’s developer portal. Our video tutorial walks through each step: Watch Tutorial

Why is my instagram feed not loading?

Check if your access token is valid. Tokens expire and need periodic renewal. Re-generate a token if it stopped working.

Can I display an instagram reels video?

Yes. The plugin supports fetching and playing reels. A play icon will show on the video.

How do I customize my instagram gallery?

Use the settings page in your dashboard. You can set columns, image spacing, and captions.

Will this social media gallery slow down my site?

No. Images load from external servers, not your hosting. This keeps your website loading fast.

Can I link an instagram post to the original page?

Yes. You can enable link redirection in settings. This redirects clicks to the instagram photo feed.

Does it work with private accounts?

No. Only public account posts can be fetched. Switch your account to public to display photos.
